Info for R researchers.

## Can include code chunks

### In R

```{r}
round(exp(1i * pi) + 1, digits = 2)
```

### and can include graphs


```{r}
pie(
  c(Sky = 78, "Sunny side of pyramid" = 17, "Shady side of pyramid" = 5),
  init.angle = 315,
  col = c("deepskyblue", "yellow", "yellow3"),
  border = FALSE
)
```
